title: Middle East Peril Codes (v2.10)
text:
Middle East Peril Codes (v2.10)

UNICEDE
/2 supports the following codes for
 Perils Covered for the risks in the Middle East supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

| Use... | If risks are covered for... |
| --- | --- |
| PWS | Wind |
| PEQ | Earthquake |
| PFL | Flood |
| PFO | Fire |
